Summary: Arthur frowned. "Are you trying to get rid of me?" Merlin coughed to hide a laugh; it was surprisingly astute of Arthur to have noticed. Merlin, since you have finished your research, you can assist Prince Arthur." After being sent to Camelot under the care of Geoffrey of Monmouth, Merlin spends his first few weeks working in the royal library. It seems like the perfect place to hide away from the tyrannical, magic-hating King Uther—until Prince Arthur comes barging into Merlin's life. Turns out it's not so easy to escape destiny's hand.
